checks.name: USDT input selector
checks.details: Raw input corresponds to the documented ERC-20 transfer selector.

checks.name: USDT input recipient
checks.details: First ABI word address matches acquired decoded input.

checks.name: USDT raw amount
checks.details: Input integer and acquired transfer amount agree; does not assert complete Storage diff.

checks.name: USDT fee
checks.details: Transaction-level execution fee agrees with actual fee metadata.

checks.name: Swap count and parent coverage
checks.details: Eight including root; every child has its parent in acquired trace.

checks.name: Swap retained records
checks.details: Four acquired logs, no next-page cursor.

checks.name: Swap frame errors
checks.details: Acquired frames have no error; top-level metadata says success.

checks.name: Native to WETH deposit
checks.details: Root native amount matches internal WETH deposit and raw Deposit log amount.

checks.name: WETH deposit is not raw Transfer
checks.details: Explorer token_minting category is separate from raw event signature.

checks.name: Swap signed settlement
checks.details: Raw Swap int256 amounts agree with native input and root returned output quantity.

checks.name: Pool returned settlement
checks.details: Pool raw return agrees with retained Swap log.

checks.name: Output Transfer amount
checks.details: Raw output-token Transfer agrees with root return, not summed into input quantity.

checks.name: Pool WETH read difference
checks.details: Two raw balanceOf return values differ by acquired WETH input; not a complete all-account State Diff.

checks.name: Swap burn and priority
checks.details: Acquired burn and priority components sum to actual execution fee.
